title: Beckn context extension: context.bacp
description: Added to Beckn/ONDC context on every BACP-originated message. Non-BACP NPs ignore it. Mirrored in message.order.tags[descriptor.code=bacp] where a network validator rejects unknown context keys (assumption).

kb_jwt.description: Agent key-binding JWT (aud = bpp_id, nonce = message_id) closing the open mandate

mandate_ref.description: REQUIRED on init, confirm, update, cancel and IGM issue. Optional on search/select.

ai_disclosure.description: Always true: the message was originated by an AI agent. REQUIRED, and mirrored in the bacp tag group where context.bacp may be stripped.

log_head.description: Current InstructionLog head at send time

acting_for.description: Whom the agent acts for, as told to the seller. OPTIONAL. gstin and display_name are sent only when the mandate's data_scopes include ACTING_FOR; otherwise they are omitted. A sole proprietor's GSTIN or name is personal data.

operator_name.description: Legal name of the agent operator, as in its AgentCredential.

operator_grievance_contact.description: Contact of the agent operator's grievance officer (email address, tel: URI or https: URL).

profile.description: The one trade profile the session declares. OPTIONAL. Fixed when the session opens; a later message of the session with another profile is refused with capabilities_incompatible. For acceptance revocation a session is a consumer session, whatever its profile, if it declares no profile, if the buyer side's acting_for.kind is individual, or if the buyer side sends no acting_for; an offer with acceptance_revocation = waived is refused in it.
